disposition_reason: Lead and chromium were measured by AAS in 18 non-canned and 12 canned soft drinks from Chittagong; Tables 1 and 2 give per-sample mean ± SEM in mg/L.

study.design: Market survey of 18 non-canned and 12 canned carbonated soft drinks of different brands
study.method: Nitric acid digestion; AAS (Analytik Jena ZEEnit 700P)
study.qa: Calibration with Pb 0.40-1.20 ppm and Cr 5-15 ppb standards; laboratory quality assurance scheme mentioned; no CRM or recovery

controls.outcome: Pb detected 7/12 canned (0.006-0.017 mg/L) vs 8/18 non-canned (0.005-0.016 mg/L); Cr 8/12 canned (0.007-0.019) vs 11/18 non-canned (0.006-0.018 mg/L)

unresolved: Lead calibration standards (0.40-1.20 ppm) lie far above the reported sample levels (0.005-0.017 mg/L), so low-level lead values are extrapolated.
No DOI is printed in the PDF; printed year is 2015 (8(2): 153-156) while the manifest gives 2016.
